title: Flattened schema and flattened rows disagree on column names for any field containing an underscore
rationale: The two halves of the library use different key encodings. AvroSchemaFlattener joins path segments with a bare separator and explicitly cannot escape (Avro/Spark names forbid backslash); MapFlattener routes every raw field name through FlattenedPath.escapeSegment. Underscore-separated field names are the dominant Avro convention, so this is the common case, and nothing in the repo asserts that the two key sets agree.
catchesBugClass: Cross-component key-encoding divergence: two producers of the same flat namespace that disagree on escaping. Also catches any change that adds escaping to one side without the other.
cannotCatch: It says nothing about whether either encoding is individually correct. It also cannot be fixed merely by making AvroSchemaFlattener escape, because Avro forbids backslash in field names outright.

predicted.detail: The schema names a column no row contains. The DATA assertion passes in isolation, so a corpus that only checks DATA reports this document as fully lossless.
